name: modules-navigation
goal: Show five primary destinations with module categories and separate data-shape Types from persisted Models

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Daniel selected five primary destinations and limited Types to existing shared type modules. Preserve IDs, paths, shared cards and scoped revision navigation; Models represent persisted data wrappers.
